notes.title: The Machines Arena is now available on Steam!
notes.content:
TMA is back on Steam with numerous updates and features that Steam players have never had the chance to test before. While veterans from other platforms will feel right at home, those who previously played only on Steam are in for a significantly expanded and enriched game.

Here’s what’s new for Steam players:

New Features & Modes

PVE game mode: Death Run is a high-stakes, high-adrenaline PvE mode. It’s all about mastering your skills and knowing when to quit while you’re ahead. Race against the clock, defeat death, and aim for glory!

New Maps: Explore brand-new battlegrounds that will challenge your tactics and keep you on your toes.

Crossplay Compatibility: TMA is now fully crossplay-enabled! Team up or fight with friends on any platform or device.

Collectible Skins & Familiars: Customize your heroes with unique Skins and powerful Familiars. Flaunt your style in the arena and make a statement with every move.

Quality-of-life improvements: Enjoy a smoother, more polished experience with updated graphics, a fresh UI, balance improvements, and much more.


Download The Machines Arena on Steam today and cement your legacy in the arena, and don't forget to join our Discord community!

notes.title: Join the Free Playtest Today!
notes.content:
Hello Steam! To celebrate the beginning of the 13th season of The Machines Arena beta, we have decided to open up our closed beta for a limited time from TODAY until September 15th!

There's more: the top 5 players of this season will win Steam Gift Cards! Make sure to read till the end of the post!

How to join the playtest
All you need to do is smash that "Request Access" button on the homepage. Then, we will let you in as soon as possible!

Make sure to also add the game to your wishlist while at it!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/40854082/c943866fff7e4d1dfd0cffaa94bfdf428a7f97aa.png


Season rewards
Ranked Season 13 starts TODAY and will run until September 15th alongside the Steam Playtest. The top 5 players will also receive Steam Gifts rewards!

Join the closed beta for The Machines Arena

The Machines Arena Closed Beta has started and you can sign-up for it here - Closed Beta Sign-up


The Machines Arena is an adrenaline-fueled 4v4 PvP game where players battle competitively. Players engage in pulse-pounding combat mayhem, delivered from a top-down perspective. The extremely precise and smooth gameplay cannot be described in words, it needs to be experienced!
Pick a hero that suits your personality, style, and killer instinct, and dive right into the action!


Join the closed beta and prepare for the adrenaline ride of a lifetime
